title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
goal: Solve Longest Repeating Character Replacement: Sliding window: expand right, shrink left when (window size − max frequency) > k.
strategy: Sliding window: expand right, shrink left when (window size − max frequency) > k.
edgeCases: A valid window needs at most k replacements after keeping its most frequent character; repeated expansion must still respect the best-window invariant.
